criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.description: Expertise relevant to the requested work.
criteria.what_to_inspect: Solution design, capacity, interoperability, performance evidence, and fit to the stated requirements.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.what_to_inspect: Named owners, milestones, delivery timeline, staffing, dependencies, testing, training, and risk controls.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.what_to_inspect: Total cost of ownership, price structure, included services, exclusions, assumptions, and additional fees.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.what_to_inspect: Security controls, independent audit evidence, privacy practices, incident response, and stated limitations.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.what_to_inspect: Support hours, response and resolution targets, escalation, comparable delivery experience, and references.

criteria.name: Team Seniority & Continuity
criteria.description: Experience and stability of the proposed team.
criteria.what_to_inspect: Named roles, seniority, allocation, replacement controls.
red_flags: Senior team only in sales process

criteria.name: Methodology & Quality
criteria.description: Suitability and quality controls of the proposed method.
criteria.what_to_inspect: Research, delivery methods, QA, and adaptation.

criteria.name: Knowledge Transfer
criteria.description: Transfer of outputs and capability to client staff.

criteria.name: Outcome-based Pricing
criteria.description: Alignment of compensation with outputs and outcomes.

criteria.name: Relevant References
criteria.description: Evidence of success on comparable engagements.
criteria.what_to_inspect: Comparable scope, outcomes, recency, reference availability.
